Issue (plain words): Start on, clock frozen
What people saw: They clicked Start. Button said Tracking. Seconds did not move.
What we fixed: Start now starts a real session and the clock always moves.
Notes: Old leftover 3:55 number cannot freeze the clock.

Issue (plain words): Start then stop after 2–3 seconds
What people saw: Clock ran a few seconds, then Stop. Start was clickable again.
What we fixed: An old Stop cannot kill the new session.
Notes: Hours stay on the laptop if the server is slow.

Issue (plain words): X button stopped the day
What people saw: Closing the window ended tracking.
What we fixed: X only hides the app. Tracking continues.
Notes: Stop, Quit, lid/sleep, or idle timeout still end the session.

Issue (plain words): Clock stuck on leftover total
What people saw: Next Start showed an old total and would not add seconds.
What we fixed: Today's clock = finished time today + time since this Start.
Notes: Leftover number is display only. It is not billed twice.

Issue (plain words): Away time before Start was counted
What people saw: Idle from before they clicked Start was added to the new session.
What we fixed: Idle starts only after Start.

Issue (plain words): App hammered the database when it was busy
What people saw: Many laptops retried at once. Website looked empty or late.
What we fixed: Failed saves wait and retry later. Hours are not deleted.
Notes: Pulse can lag a few minutes. Laptop is still counting.

Issue (plain words): Screenshots blocked or vanished offline
What people saw: Capture waited on upload, or shots were dropped.
What we fixed: Shots save on the laptop first. Upload is in the background.

Issue (plain words): Not-tracking reminder too soon / too noisy
What people saw: Popup while they were between sessions.
What we fixed: Reminder is 10 minutes after Stop then every 10 minutes.

Issue (plain words): Extra phantom hours on one day
What people saw: One person's Sep 15 hours were too high.
What we fixed: One-time cleanup for that day only.
Notes: Do not reuse that cleanup unless asked.

Issue (plain words): Clock back to 0 after midnight
What people saw: Clock reset at company midnight.
What we fixed: No change. Work day follows company timezone (Chicago).
Notes: Do not treat as a defect.

Issue (plain words): Lid / sleep stopped tracking
What people saw: Time froze when laptop slept.
What we fixed: No change. Sleep is not billed. They click Start after wake.

Issue (plain words): Pulse effective lower than laptop clock
What people saw: Website effective hours less than the big desktop clock.
What we fixed: No change. Desktop clock = full time. Pulse effective = minus long idle / low activity.
Notes: Compare Pulse tracked to the laptop, not effective.

Issue (plain words): Two sessions at the same time
What people saw: The same person had overlapping sessions. Work time could be counted twice.
What we fixed: A person can only have one live session per device. A new Start closes the old one.
Notes: Two laptops at once are still allowed.

Issue (plain words): Finished time could still be changed
What people saw: Sessions already marked complete were edited later — sometimes hours after Stop, sometimes made longer.
What we fixed: Once a session is finished later writes cannot stretch it.
Notes: Matches hours are not locking correctly.

Issue (plain words): Deleting screenshots removed too much time
What people saw: Screenshot deductions were larger than the session itself. One ~59 minute session lost ~168 minutes.
What we fixed: A deduction cannot be larger than that session. Repeat uploads do not stack the same cut.
Notes: Stops net time going negative or far too low.

Issue (plain words): Crash / sleep left a still running session
What people saw: After sleep or the app dying, the server still had an open session and could keep counting.
What we fixed: Open sessions are closed at the last moment we know they were awake.

Issue (plain words): Idle on the screen did not match the database
What people saw: Every time-log row showed 0 idle seconds, but the app UI showed hours of idle (example 2h 36m).
What we fixed: Idle is stored in one place and used by both the app and Pulse.
Notes: Payroll, reports, and the UI must use the same idle number.

Issue (plain words): Very short sessions padded to 30 seconds
What people saw: Many completed sessions were exactly 30 seconds. Stored end time was often ~20 seconds after they actually stopped.
What we fixed: Stop time is the real Stop or last awake proof. No 30-second pad.
Notes: Short clicks no longer inflate hours or create overlaps.

Issue (plain words): Could not tell which app version caused a failure
What people saw: Audit logs had no app version and no request id.
What we fixed: Each session and audit event records app version and request id where we have it.
Notes: Needed to debug which release did this.

Issue (plain words): Leftover clock showed fake today time
What people saw: Without restarting the app, the clock showed extra time (example 44m 55s on screen vs 11m 50s in the database). Start then snapped down.
What we fixed: Leftover clock memory is not today's billed time. Start uses the database / closed sessions only.
Notes: Same family as issue 4. Extra must not seed the next session.

Issue (plain words): Meetings marked not productive
What people saw: Meeting screenshots were scored as unproductive, especially on two monitors.
What we fixed: A live meeting is treated as medium activity (~50%) not idle / not-productive.
Notes: AI was treating the other screen as not working.

Issue (plain words): App used too much battery / CPU
What people saw: Occasional energy spikes. Laptop fans up, battery drain.
What we fixed: Removed tight retry loops and constant 10-second server pings. Sync happens on events with backoff.
Notes: Spikes should be rare now. Still watch Windows vs Mac after release.
